dimensions.detail: The skill is an instruction-only wrapper that collects user-provided control maturity values and POSTs them to https://portal.toolweb.in/apis/security/it-risk-assessment. Requesting curl and a single API key (TOOLWEB_API_KEY) is coherent with that purpose, and the declared homepage matches the API host.

llm.guidance: This skill appears internally consistent, but before installing: (1) verify you trust portal.toolweb.in (confirm domain, TLS cert, company) and review their privacy/retention and pricing policies; (2) limit the API key's scope and rotate/revoke it if needed (use a key dedicated to this tool, not a broad account key); (3) avoid sending highly sensitive secrets or raw credentials as part of responses—only send control maturity ratings as asked; (4) test with non-sensitive example data first and monitor API usage/costs; (5) review the full SKILL.md in the package (it was truncated in the listing) to ensure there are no additional instructions that change data collection or transmission behavior.
